skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recall key concepts, principles, and theories related to labor relations.
Understand and differentiate basic differences and relationships between labor relations concepts and legal texts.
Understand roles, motivations, and behaviors of actors in labor relations.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing internal and external factors affecting labor relations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the differences between internal and external factors affecting labor relations.
Understand and evaluate development trends in labor relations within organizations.
Compare and contrast the characteristics of labor relations in public organizations with other organizations and internationally.
Analyze real-life labor relations scenarios and assess decisions made by key actors based on theoretical knowledge and labor laws.
Proficiently use quantitative and qualitative analysis techniques for labor relations data analysis.
Proactively engage in learning, research, and group work. Adapt to different working environments and form professional ethics and responsibilities.
Proactively choose topics, research methods, and present research findings.
